title: Payments logs show KeyError on some charges
query: Some charge requests in payments blow up with a KeyError in the logs, but others succeed. What should we do?
root_cause: A regression in the new payments release makes some charge requests raise an unhandled error.

remediation.detail: Roll payments back to the previous version (v1.0.0).

evidence: Payments logs contain unhandled exception entries with KeyError
Only part of the charge requests fail, so the error ratio is partial
The version field in payments logs changed to v1.1.0
query_paraphrase: In the payments logs I keep seeing a crash about a missing key on some charges, yet other charges go through fine. What's the move here?
